mapper.select:
SELECT b.id, b.name, b.book_type_id, b.adaptation_type_id, b.region_id, b.publish_date, b.cover_image_url, b.status, b.volume_count, b.chapter_count, b.created_at, b.updated_at FROM book b LEFT JOIN personal_rating pr ON pr.target_type = 'BOOK' AND pr.target_id = b.id
AND (LOWER(b.name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{pageDTO.keyword}) || '%' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM alias al WHERE al.target_type = 'BOOK' AND al.target_id = b.id AND LOWER(al.alias_name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{pageDTO.keyword}) || '%') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM series_item si INNER JOIN series s ON s.id = si.series_id WHERE si.work_type = 'book' AND si.work_id = b.id AND LOWER(s.name) LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{pageDTO.keyword}) || '%'))
AND b.book_type_id = #{pageDTO.bookTypeId} AND b.adaptation_type_id = #{pageDTO.adaptationTypeId} AND b.region_id = #{pageDTO.regionId} AND b.status = #{pageDTO.status} AND b.publish_date >= #{startDate} AND b.publish_date <= #{endDate}
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM company_relation cr WHERE cr.target_type = 'BOOK' AND cr.target_id = b.id AND cr.company_id = #{pageDTO.companyId})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person_relation per WHERE per.target_type = 'BOOK' AND per.target_id = b.id AND per.person_id = #{pageDTO.personId})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM series_item si WHERE si.work_type = 'book' AND si.work_id = b.id AND si.series_id = #{pageDTO.seriesId})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tag_relation tr WHERE tr.target_type = 'BOOK' AND tr.target_id = b.id AND tr.tag_id IN #{tagId})
AND (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tr.tag_id) FROM tag_relation tr WHERE tr.target_type = 'BOOK' AND tr.target_id = b.id AND tr.tag_id IN #{tagId}) = #{tagCount}
AND pr.score >= #{pageDTO.ratingMin} AND pr.score <= #{pageDTO.ratingMax}
ORDER BY
pr.score b.publish_date
ASC DESC
NULLS LAST, b.id DESC
